records.title: GREEN HYDROGEN HUB.
details: c to d: Under the Mission, it is proposed to be set up at least two Green Hydrogen hubs by FY 2025-26.

records.title: Impact of Hoax calls to Aviation Sector
details: Part (e) & (f) It is being considered to amend the Aircraft (Security) Rules, 2023 to put hoax threat messenger in NO FLY LIST. It is also being considered to amend suppression of unlawful acts against safety of Civil Aviation for covering Aircraft in flight as well as on ground, airport etc.
